name: Shizuoka

queries.query: Shizuoka City official cadastral parcel map GIS land registry public map API
queries.result: Found the official Shizuoka City pages for the city GIS and cadastral-map application procedure. The official page says the city GIS includes the latest fixed-asset-tax parcel reference map and building-outline map, but no anonymous parcel feature endpoint was established.

queries.query: 静岡市 公式 地籍図 公図 GIS 土地 筆界 地番 地図
queries.result: Found official Shizuoka City pages stating that cadastral maps show each parcel boundary, lot number and shape, and directing users to the city GIS's latest fixed-asset-tax parcel reference map/building-outline map. The city cadastral-survey page describes local cadastral-survey results and issuance, not an open parcel API.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official city GIS page. The listed layers include 固定資産税地番参考図・家屋外形図 (fixed-asset-tax parcel reference map/building-outline map).

Official procedure page says cadastral maps show one-parcel boundaries, lot numbers and shape; it directs users to the city GIS for the latest parcel reference map and says cadastral-map copies are issued through municipal offices.
